created.description: False when this exact file was already stored.

added.description: Entries the previous latest version lacked.

retired.description: Entries newly retired since the previous latest version.

thin.description: True when the description is only a snippet or missing.

line.description: A line location such as "summary[0]" or "experiences[0].bullets[1]".

summary.description: One line per Highlight of Qualifications.

experiences.description: List every fixed Experience with no bullets.

postingText.description: Pasted Posting text for a Thin Posting. Stored, never returned with the draft.

rule.description: 1 to 5 are the Trace check rules, 6 is a stale profile version, shape is a malformed draft.

text.description: A Fact's text, or the name of any other Entry.

reviewedAt.description: Null while the entry waits for review. Exact-key and manual merges are stored reviewed.

posting.description: The merged Posting as it is now, with every Sighting it holds.

postings.description: The two Postings, the lower id first.

jobSources.description: Every Job source that reported this URL.

id.description: The id the merge and dismiss endpoints take.

feedCorrection.description: The user's newest Feed correction, or null. It is never a Label.

tier.description: Null when no Tier has been computed yet.
